RIA DigiDoc is an application that can be used to sign digitally with mobile-ID, Smart-ID and Estonian ID-card, check the validity of digital signatures and open, save and share documents with the mobile phone. Digitally signed containers are files with .bdoc, .ddoc or .asice extensions.

With the RIA DigiDoc app, you can check your ID-card certificate validity, change the PIN and PUK codes. „My eID“ selection displays the ID-card owner’s data and ID-card validity data. This information is visible only when ID-card is in the reader. 

Requirements for use with an ID-card:
Feitian iR301U
https://www.ftsafe.com/Products/Card_Reader/iOS_Reader/Specification
